recipe.title: Tuscan-Style Savory Beef Ragù with Rigatoni
recipe.description: A rich, slow-simmered Tuscan ground beef ragù layered with aromatics, red wine, and herbs, tossed with al dente rigatoni. Pure comfort food that is entirely dairy-free.

ingredients.item: Dry red wine (or extra beef stock)

instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the pasta.

Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef, season with salt and pepper, and brown thoroughly for 6-8 minutes, breaking it up with a wooden spoon. Transfer meat to a plate, leaving rendered fat in the skillet.
Add remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil to the skillet along with diced onion, carrot, and celery. Cook over medium heat for 6-7 minutes until vegetables are soft and sweet.
Stir in minced garlic and tomato paste. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly until tomato paste turns a deep brick-red color.
Pour in red wine to deglaze the pan, scraping up all the savory browned bits from the bottom. Simmer for 2 minutes until reduced by half.
Return browned beef to skillet. Add crushed tomatoes, beef stock, rosemary, and thyme. Reduce heat to low, cover partially, and let simmer gently for 20 minutes to meld flavors.
While sauce simmers, cook rigatoni according to package directions until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of starchy pasta water before draining.

Discard rosemary stem and thyme sprigs from sauce. Toss drained pasta directly into ragù over low heat, adding 2-3 tablespoons of reserved pasta water to help the sauce cling to pasta without dairy. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.

tips: Reserving starchy pasta water is essential for dairy-free sauces—it emulsifies with olive oil and tomato juices to create a glossy finish without butter or cheese.
Finely dicing the soffritto (onion, carrot, celery) allows the vegetables to melt into the meat sauce, providing natural sweetness and body.
